name: carrysync-kit
description: One Foundation. Two Applications. Zero Network Required for Data Exchange.

scripts.dev:field: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace=@carrysync/field-ledger
scripts.dev:quiz: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace=@carrysync/quiz-relay
scripts.build: npm run build:camera && npm run build --workspace=@carrysync/field-ledger && npm run build --workspace=@carrysync/quiz-relay && npm run build:harness
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:camera && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:camera && npm run build:harness && playwright test
scripts.verify:import: npm run build:camera && node scripts/verify-import.mjs && node scripts/verify-storage-import.mjs && node scripts/verify-core-isolation.mjs && node scripts/verify-camera-import.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:import
scripts.build:indexeddb: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=@carrysync/indexeddb
scripts.build:camera: npm run build:indexeddb && npm run build --workspace=@carrysync/camera
